sources.claim: The documentation records that on macOS monotonic became the same clock for all processes in Python 3.10.
The macOS branch initializes a static process-local t0 from mach_absolute_time and subtracts t0 before conversion.
The macOS branch converts mach_absolute_time ticks without the Python 3.9 process-local subtraction.
